name: Aimco Pesticides Limited
about: Aimco Pesticides Limited manufactures, markets, sells, and exports agrochemical products in India and internationally. The company offers chlorpyrifos, triclopyr, bifenthrin, thiamethoxam, and paclobutrazole formulations. It also offers formulations comprising insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, biostimulant, antibiotic, bio-fertilisers, micronutrients, and rodenticides, as well as plant growth regulators. The company sells its products under the AIMCO brand. The company exports its products to approximately 45 countries. Aimco Pesticides Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
